notes.title: Version 1.03

 Updated overworld map to display current progress.
 Added Control remapping option. 
 Added Fullscreen option.


Gameplay Adjustments:

 Adjusted Stage 1 level layout.

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.content:
Gameplay Adjustments:
Normal mode:

 Reaching a checkpoint will now restore HP.
 Key item (Friendship Mic) will no longer disappear after reaching a checkpoint.


Bug Fix:

 Fixed an issue where the boss character would stop moving after being hit.
 Resolved a performance issue where the game would default to using the integrated GPU instead of the dedicated GPU.
 Fixed issue with unreachable areas in Bonus Stage 2.
 Adjusted light follow speed in Underground Stage to prevent getting stuck.

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.content:
Gameplay Adjustments:

     Redesigned Stage 1 level layout.
     Platform behavior updated: Platforms will only disappear if the player steps on them.
     Players will no longer lose HP when remaining underwater for a set period of time.


New Features:
    Normal Mode added:

         Existing game saves will default to Normal Mode.
         To revert to Hard Mode, press Esc/Pause in the overworld and select the Difficulty option.


Normal Mode Adjustments:

     Increased stage timer.
     Reduced damage taken.
     Spikes no longer instantly kill the player.
